defaultCallingCode.title: Default calling code
defaultCallingCode.description: Added to phone numbers typed without a country code, for example +44 or +1. Empty: your country's code from business.json; without one, numbers must start with + or 00.

trunkPrefix.title: Prefix to drop from national numbers
trunkPrefix.description: Dropped from a national number before the calling code is added, for example 0. Empty: the usual prefix of your country.

channel.title: Send codes by
channel.description: The channel Notifications sends phone codes on: sign-in codes and Forgot password codes (template accounts.phone_code), and invites to a phone number.

websitePerHour.title: Codes per hour for the whole website
